build_notes: The official project requires Unity 2021.3.45f2 but pins Shader Graph 14.0.9, whose package declares Unity 2022.3. This dependency combination has not been compiled here.
The official README warns of occasional null-pointer crashes when built with Unity 2022.3. The build entry preserves the official 2021.3.45f2 requirement without claiming verified compatibility.
modifications: UIOperate.Awake attaches QuestUsbConnection to the existing scene object.
QuestUsbConnection starts a USB loopback connection, with optional launch extras, without changing tracking controls.
TcpHandler retries initial and subsequent connection failures with bounded backoff and isolates stale socket callbacks.
QuestUsbBuild validates the real scene and builds an independent Android application id.
